errors.text_span: Each bar includes error bars indicating variability. For IE-Baltic, all bars are relatively small, ranging from roughly 1 to 5. IE-Germanic shows bars around 0 to 15, with XLM-B₂ reaching approximately 15. IE-Indic displays the tallest bars overall, with mBERT-B₂ reaching approximately 24 and XLM-B₂ around 21, while mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ are around 18 and 17 respectively. IE-Romance bars range from roughly 1 to 13. IE-Slavic shows values from about 5 to 17, with XLM-B₂ being the tallest at approximately 17. IE-other has bars ranging from about 5 to 8. Isolate shows very small bars near 0 with minimal variation. Semitic displays notable variation, with mBERT-L₂ around 11 and some bars (mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂) appearing slightly negative, near -1 to -2, while XLM-B₂ reaches approximately 20 with large error bars. Uralic bars are mostly near 0, with XLM-B₂ reaching approximately 19 but accompanied by very large error bars extending well above 30.
errors.evidence: The description is overly detailed and repetitive, listing values for each group without adding significant informational value.
